concept.title: Marriage Pvt. Ltd.
concept.human_truth: Marriage looks like two people running separate departments, but daily life keeps making them cross roles and cover each other's shifts.
concept.emotional_arc: separate departments -> mutual guilt -> reciprocal competence -> departments collapse -> partnership remains
concept.visual_system: One lived evening inside a two-person home-company, with real domestic actions rather than literal corporate graphics.

slides.copy:
Every marriage is a two-person company
with too many departments.
slides.visual: Wide doorway view inside a lived home. Aachu and Zuv cross in opposite directions while already handling multiple household tasks: Aachu carries a small shopping bag and keys; Zuv holds a plain budget notebook while looking for something. They exchange one familiar knowing glance. The home is the office; no literal corporate props.
slides.pose: Both walking naturally, distinct silhouettes, Zuv only about two inches taller, no posed embrace.
slides.wardrobe: Continuous evening wardrobe anchored to identity references: Aachu in a soft coral casual top and blue jeans; Zuv in a cream casual shirt and charcoal trousers.
slides.props: Small unbranded shopping bag, keys, completely blank notebook.
slides.background: Specific apartment threshold and living-room edge with warm practical lamp, no people, portraits, signs, or readable labels.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two people and four traceable hands. Establish separate motion that will converge by slide 9.

slides.copy:
FINANCE
One says, “Budget.”
The other says, “Sale mein tha.”
Both have receipts.
slides.visual: Over-the-shoulder dining-table view. Zuv points to one number line in a blank budget notebook. Aachu calmly slides a sale receipt beside it, then taps his own unnecessary expense on a second receipt. His raised eyebrow drops while she suppresses a smile.
slides.pose: Aachu seated three-quarter profile, Zuv opposite in partial over-shoulder profile; no one scolds or dominates.
slides.props: Blank notebook with abstract lines but no readable writing, exactly two receipts with no legible microtext, one small shopping bag.
slides.background: Dining corner, warm pendant light, sparse causal detail only.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two people. Both must visibly possess evidence; neither is the sole irresponsible partner.

slides.copy:
LOST & FOUND
“Kahan hai?”
One points.
Five minutes later, roles reverse.
slides.visual: Deep-focus living-room scene. Aachu searches beside a console for her keys while Zuv silently points to them in plain sight. In the background his phone rests on the sofa arm he has just checked, and Aachu has already noticed it. The visual promises the immediate role reversal.
slides.pose: Aachu foreground searching, Zuv midground pointing, eye-lines link finger to keys and Aachu to his phone.
slides.props: One keyring, one face-down phone with no UI.
slides.background: Living-room console and sofa edge; no mirrors, portraits, extra figures, or decorative clutter.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two people. Each visible hand must connect cleanly to its owner. No duplicate keys or phones.

slides.copy:
TRAVEL
One packed the charger.
The other remembered the passport.
slides.visual: Low wide view over an open suitcase. Aachu holds up a neatly coiled charger triumphantly. At the doorway Zuv raises the passport she forgot. Their eyes meet across the suitcase with equal sheepish satisfaction.
slides.pose: Aachu kneels beside suitcase; Zuv stands at doorway with natural two-inch height difference irrelevant to power.
slides.props: One charger, one passport with plain cover and no readable emblem or text, one open suitcase with plausible contents.
slides.background: Bedroom-to-doorway depth, warm evening practical light.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two people. Charger and passport have unambiguous owners and separate hands.

slides.copy:
LEGAL
Both have screenshots.
Neither has the full context.
slides.visual: Tight overhead and over-shoulder hybrid view at the table. Two phones enter from opposite sides, each held by its owner and angled toward the other. Their free index fingers meet near the center as both present harmless contradictory evidence. Faces remain partially visible with amused, stubborn expressions. Phone screens show only soft abstract message shapes, never readable UI or invented text.
slides.pose: Aachu and Zuv lean in equally from opposite sides, balanced power, no aggression.
slides.props: Exactly two phones; abstract non-readable screen blocks only.
slides.background: Plain tabletop with the earlier receipts softly out of focus as continuity evidence.
slides.continuity_lock: Highest-risk proof. Exactly two people, exactly four visible hands, two phones, no extra arms, no readable phone text, no hostility.

slides.copy:
IT SUPPORT
Wi-Fi nahi chal raha?
One checks the router.
The other finds the loose plug.
slides.visual: Low close view near the media console. Zuv crouches beside the router checking its buttons while Aachu follows the cable and reconnects the loose wall plug. Router lights switch on; he looks up and she gives a tiny satisfied shrug.
slides.pose: Zuv crouched with stable anatomy; Aachu kneeling at safe distance, both focused on different parts of one system.
slides.props: One router without labels, one continuous cable, one wall plug and socket.
slides.background: Media-console edge with clean wall plane; no TV UI, reflections, portraits, or extra devices.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two people. Trace cable continuously and every hand owner-to-arm. No impossible socket or body-wall intersection.

slides.copy:
EMERGENCY
Midnight hunger.
No departments.
Full team activation.
slides.visual: High-angle midnight kitchen climax. Aachu opens the cupboard and passes ingredients while Zuv sets a pan on the stove and reaches for plates. Their eye-lines are task-focused, their body distance has contracted, and all objects move through a clear shared workflow.
slides.pose: Both upright and active at separate stations, no embrace or posed smile.
slides.wardrobe: Same clothes with natural sleeves slightly rolled for late-night cooking continuity.
slides.props: One pan, two plates, a few simple unbranded ingredients; no packaging text.
slides.background: Dark home around one warm kitchen light pool; foreground counter, midground action, quiet background.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two people. No open flame near fabric, no anonymous hands, no extra diners.

slides.copy:
HEAD OFFICE
Nobody is in charge.
Both think they are.
slides.visual: Symmetrical medium view during post-cooking cleanup. Aachu wipes the counter while simultaneously pointing Zuv toward the plates; Zuv carries the plates while simultaneously pointing her toward the loose cupboard door. They notice their mirrored instructions and begin laughing.
slides.pose: Shoulder-to-shoulder distance but separate tasks, mirrored free-hand gestures, warm eye contact.
slides.props: Cleaning cloth, exactly two plates, one cupboard door.
slides.background: Same kitchen as slide 7 from a frontal angle, visibly calmer after the action.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two people and four traceable hands. Mutual authority, no boss chair, office costume, or gender caricature.

slides.copy:
No fixed roles.
Just two people covering
each other’s shift.
slides.visual: Quiet floor-level release in the kitchen. Aachu and Zuv sit shoulder-to-shoulder sharing the midnight food from the two plates. The earlier keys, charger and two face-down phones appear naturally at the periphery as subtle callbacks. Their posture is relaxed and familiar; the departments have disappeared.
slides.pose: Seated close with natural height difference, no staged hug, both looking at the shared food and then each other.
slides.wardrobe: Same continuous evening wardrobe, relaxed after action.
slides.props: Two plates, one pan softly behind, keys, one coiled charger, two face-down phones; no notebook or readable paper.
slides.background: Kitchen floor and lower cabinets fading into warm ivory paper, clean upper-middle negative space.
slides.continuity_lock: Exactly two people. End with synchronized stillness after separate motion; no extra figures, reflections, text, or symbolic corporate props.

copy.caption_recommended: Marriage has no proper job descriptions. The budget department shops. The travel department forgets things. IT support needs support. And during a midnight emergency, everyone reports for duty. Nobody really knows who is in charge. Somehow, both keep covering each other’s shift. Send this to your co-founder. 🤝
